resource.ask: How to reach the controller: tcp://<ip>:7777 (Ethernet on the 336/350), a GPIB VISA resource, or a TCPIP VISA resource
resource.help: The 336 and 350 show their IP address under Interface > Ethernet; the raw command port is 7777. GPIB (all three models): GPIB0::12::INSTR, address 12 is the factory default. The USB port is a virtual COM port at 57600 baud 7 data bits odd parity, which this generic route does not open; see references/setup.md. `pyvisa` lists what it can see; with none installed, type the string.
